description: MUC2 (NM_002457.5) and SHANK3 (NM_001372044.2) on GRCh38.p14, RefSeq annotation RS_2025_08, with NCBI's transcript-to-genome alignments (GCF_000001405.40_GRCh38.p14_knownrefseq_alns.bam, md5 42eccd19b4ce9d0b6c1808591e9223b7) cut into per-exon cigars. MUC2 differs from the genome by 2,919 transcript-only bases and 25 substitutions, mostly in one repeat exon; SHANK3 by 39 transcript-only bases, 4 genome-only bases and 1 substitution. Cigars read in transcript orientation with the genome as the reference side: `=` match, `X` substitution, `I` transcript-only base, `D` genome-only base. Coordinates are 0-based; transcript_end is exclusive, reference_end inclusive; cds indices are inclusive and cds_end_index is the stop codon's last base. The genome is a window per chromosome served under the chromosome accession: real genomic coordinate = rebased + windows[chromosome].start.

cases.note: ClinVar 2641150, Likely benign. The record has C where the genome has G; the projected reference must be the genome's G.
The record's reference at c.12468 is C.
Validation is against the record, and passes.
VariantValidator: ReferenceMismatchError, variant reference (G) does not agree with reference sequence (C).

ClinVar 2653415, Likely benign, C allele at 0.94-0.96 in gnomAD. The record already carries C, so the projection is no change. The position is 2 bases into an exon whose cigar starts 1=1X3=2D; the previous exon ends in 39 transcript-only bases.
The inverse: no change on the record is the substitution T>C on the genome.
Stating the genome's T as the alternate on the record is no change on the genome.
c.1568 is C on the record; VariantValidator returns c.1568= for the genome's T>C.
